style.vernacular: Humid tropical Caribbean capital: reinforced-concrete frame and hollow-block buildings with flat roofs (often with rooftop water tanks and rebar stubs), painted in cream, ochre, pastel green and white; louvred jalousie windows and balconies; a 16th-century Colonial City of golden coral limestone and masonry (cathedral, forts, palaces) with clay-tile roofs; mid-century modernist concrete civic buildings; glass mid-rise towers on the Malecon and Piantini; corrugated zinc sheet roofs on lower-income housing; royal palms and almond trees.
style.ornament: Colonial City coral-limestone arches, Gothic-Plateresque portals and battlements; louvred jalousie windows; concrete balconies with metal railings; pastel painted bands on shop-fronts; monumental concrete forms such as the cross-shaped Columbus Lighthouse.
